"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf."""
import os
from datetime import date

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

REPORT = "report.pdf"
COVER = "cover_page.pdf"

# 1. Verify the input report exists
if not os.path.exists(REPORT):
    raise SystemExit(f"Error: {REPORT} not found in workspace")

original = PdfReader(REPORT)
original_page_count = len(original.pages)
print(f"Found {REPORT} with {original_page_count} pages")

# 2. Build the cover page with the title and current date
today = date.today()
date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")
print(f"Current date: {date_str}")

c = canvas.Canvas(COVER, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

# Title
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 + 30, "Annual Financial Report")

# Date
c.setFont("Helvetica", 18)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 - 30, date_str)

c.save()
print(f"Created cover page: {COVER}")

# 3. Prepend the cover page to report.pdf
writer = PdfWriter()
cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER)
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in original.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(REPORT, "wb") as out:
    writer.write(out)
print(f"Wrote {REPORT} with {len(writer.pages)} pages (cover + {original_page_count})")

# 4. Verify the result
check = PdfReader(REPORT)
first_page_text = check.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
print("--- Verification: first page text ---")
print(first_page_text.strip())
assert "Annual Financial Report" in first_page_text, "Title missing from cover page"
assert date_str in first_page_text, "Date missing from cover page"
assert len(check.pages) == original_page_count + 1, "Unexpected page count"
print("Verification passed.")

import importlib.util

mods = [
    "pypdf",
    "PyPDF2",
    "pdfplumber",
    "reportlab",
    "fitz",  # PyMuPDF
    "pdfrw",
    "pikepdf",
    "pydf",
]
for m in mods:
    spec = importlib.util.find_spec(m)
    print(f"{m}: {'available' if spec else 'NOT available'}")

import shutil

tools = [
    "qpdf",
    "pdftk",
    "pdftotext",
    "pdfinfo",
    "pdfunite",
    "pdftoppm",
    "gs",
    "mutool",
    "pdfjam",
    "python",
]
for t in tools:
    print(f"{t}: {shutil.which(t)}")

"""Inspect report.pdf structure without any third-party libraries."""
import os
import re

PATH = "report.pdf"

if not os.path.exists(PATH):
    raise SystemExit("report.pdf not found")

size = os.path.getsize(PATH)
print(f"File size: {size} bytes")

with open(PATH, "rb") as f:
    data = f.read()

print("\n--- First 300 bytes ---")
print(data[:300].decode("latin-1", errors="replace"))

print("\n--- Last 500 bytes ---")
print(data[-500:].decode("latin-1", errors="replace"))

print("\n--- Key markers ---")
for marker in [b"/Type /Pages", b"/Type/Pages", b"/Type /Page", b"/Type/Page",
               b"/ObjStm", b"startxref", b"xref", b"/Encrypt", b"/Linearized",
               b"/Count ", b"/Count ", b"/Kids", b"/Root"]:
    print(f"{marker!r}: {data.count(marker)} occurrence(s)")

# Try to find startxref value
m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data[-2000:])
if m:
    xref_pos = int(m.group(1))
    print(f"\nstartxref -> {xref_pos}")
    print("Bytes at xref position:", data[xref_pos:xref_pos+80].decode("latin-1", errors="replace"))

"""Dump report.pdf fully with byte offsets for planning."""
PATH = "report.pdf"
with open(PATH, "rb") as f:
    data = f.read()

print(f"Total size: {len(data)} bytes\n")
# Show each object's raw bytes (from xref offsets to next offset)
offsets = [61, 102, 209, 321, 514, 582, 843, 902]
for i, off in enumerate(offsets):
    end = offsets[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(offsets) else 1763
    chunk = data[off:end]
    print(f"=== Object {i+1} @ {off}..{end} ({len(chunk)} bytes) ===")
    print(chunk.decode("latin-1", errors="replace"))
    print()

"""Prepend a cover page to report.pdf using only the Python standard library.

Strategy (validated against the actual file structure):
  - report.pdf is PDF 1.3, classic xref, not encrypted, no object streams.
  - Keep all original object numbers; copy their raw bytes verbatim.
  - Add new objects: 9 (cover Page), 10 (cover content stream).
  - Rewrite object 7 (/Pages) with /Count 2 and Kids [ 9 0 R 4 0 R ].
  - Emit a fresh classic xref table + trailer.
"""

import os
import re
import time
from datetime import date

SRC = "report.pdf"

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Standard AFM widths for the base-14 fonts (chars 32..126, 95 entries)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
HELV = [278,278,355,556,556,889,667,191,333,333,389,584,278,333,278,278,
        556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,278,278,584,584,584,556,
        1015,667,667,722,722,667,611,778,722,278,500,667,556,833,722,778,
        667,778,722,667,611,722,667,944,667,667,611,278,278,278,469,556,
        333,556,556,500,556,556,278,556,556,222,222,500,222,833,556,556,
        556,556,333,500,278,556,500,722,500,500,500,334,260,334,584]
HELV_BOLD = [278,333,474,556,556,889,722,238,333,333,389,584,278,333,278,278,
             556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,333,333,584,584,584,611,
             975,722,722,722,722,667,611,778,722,278,556,722,611,833,722,778,
             667,778,722,667,611,722,667,944,667,667,611,333,278,333,584,556,
             333,556,611,556,611,556,333,611,611,278,278,556,278,889,611,611,
             611,611,389,556,333,611,556,778,556,556,500,389,280,389,584]
assert len(HELV) == 95 and len(HELV_BOLD) == 95, "width tables must have 95 entries"


def string_width(s, bold, size):
    widths = HELV_BOLD if bold else HELV
    total = 0
    for ch in s:
        o = ord(ch)
        total += widths[o - 32] if 32 <= o <= 126 else 556
    return total * size / 1000.0


def esc_pdf_string(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def find_line_end(data, p):
    """Return index just past the next newline (handles \\r\\n)."""
    i = data.find(b"\n", p)
    if i == -1:
        raise ValueError("unterminated line")
    return i + 1


def find_dict_end(data, start):
    """Return index of the '>>' closing the dict that starts at 'start' ('<<')."""
    depth = 0
    i = start
    n = len(data)
    while i < n:
        c = data[i]
        if c == ord("("):
            # literal string; skip to matching close, honoring backslash escapes
            depth_str = 0
            i += 1
            while i < n:
                if data[i] == ord("\\"):
                    i += 2
                    continue
                if data[i] == ord("("):
                    depth_str += 1
                elif data[i] == ord(")"):
                    if depth_str == 0:
                        break
                    depth_str -= 1
                i += 1
        elif c == ord("<") and i + 1 < n and data[i + 1] == ord("<"):
            depth += 1
            i += 2
            continue
        elif c == ord(">") and i + 1 < n and data[i + 1] == ord(">"):
            depth -= 1
            i += 2
            if depth == 0:
                return i - 1
            continue
        i += 1
    raise ValueError("unbalanced dict")


def parse_classic_xref(data, startxref):
    """Parse classic xref (with /Prev chains). Returns {objnum: offset}, trailer bytes."""
    entries = {}
    trailer = None
    pos = startxref
    while pos:
        if data[pos:pos + 4] != b"xref":
            raise ValueError(f"expected 'xref' at {pos}")
        p = pos + 4
        while True:
            line_end = find_line_end(data, p)
            line = data[p:line_end].rstrip(b"\r\n")
            if not line:
                p = line_end
                continue
            if line == b"trailer":
                ds = data.index(b"<<", p)
                de = find_dict_end(data, ds)
                trailer = data[ds:de + 2]
                m = re.search(rb"/Prev\s+(\d+)", trailer)
                pos = int(m.group(1)) if m else 0
                break
            parts = line.split()
            start = int(parts[0])
            count = int(parts[1])
            q = line_end
            for _ in range(count):
                entry = data[q:q + 20]
                if len(entry) < 20:
                    raise ValueError("short xref entry")
                typ = entry[17:18]
                if typ == b"n":
                    entries[start] = int(entry[0:10])
                start += 1
                q += 20
            p = q
        # pos updated in the 'trailer' branch
    return entries, trailer


def read_objects(data, entries, boundary):
    """Return dict {objnum: raw bytes from 'N 0 obj' to next object start}."""
    objs = {}
    nums = sorted(entries.keys())
    for idx, num in enumerate(nums):
        off = entries[num]
        end = entries[nums[idx + 1]] if idx + 1 < len(nums) else boundary
        objs[num] = data[off:end]
    return objs


def verify_pdf(path, expect_pages, title, date_str):
    data = open(path, "rb").read()
    m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
    assert m, "no startxref"
    entries, _ = parse_classic_xref(data, int(m.group(1)))
    # every entry must point at '<num> 0 obj'
    for num, off in entries.items():
        header = data[off:off + 40]
        assert re.match(rb"^\s*%d\s+0\s+obj" % num, header), f"bad offset for obj {num}"
    # Pages object (7) must have Count == expect_pages and cover kid first
    p7 = data[entries[7]:entries[7] + 300]
    mcount = re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", p7)
    assert mcount and int(mcount.group(1)) == expect_pages, f"Pages /Count != {expect_pages}"
    assert b"/Kids [ 9 0 R 4 0 R ]" in p7, "Kids not updated"
    # Cover page object 9
    p9 = data[entries[9]:entries[9] + 300]
    assert b"/Type /Page" in p9 and b"/Parent 7 0 R" in p9, "cover page dict wrong"
    # Cover content stream object 10
    p10 = data[entries[10]:entries[10] + 4000]
    assert esc_pdf_string(title).encode("latin-1") in p10, "title missing in stream"
    assert esc_pdf_string(date_str).encode("latin-1") in p10, "date missing in stream"
    # trailer root
    trailer_start = data.rfind(b"trailer")
    assert b"/Root 5 0 R" in data[trailer_start:trailer_start + 200], "trailer root wrong"
    print("Verification passed: pages =", expect_pages, "| title + date found on cover.")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def main():
    if not os.path.exists(SRC):
        raise SystemExit(f"{SRC} not found")

    with open(SRC, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()

    m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
    assert m, "no startxref in original"
    startxref = int(m.group(1))

    entries, trailer = parse_classic_xref(data, startxref)
    if b"/Encrypt" in trailer:
        raise SystemExit("original PDF is encrypted; cannot merge safely")
    if b"/XRefStm" in trailer or b"/ObjStm" in data:
        raise SystemExit("original uses xref streams/object streams; not supported here")

    objs = read_objects(data, entries, startxref)
    orig_page_count = int(re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", objs[7]).group(1))
    print(f"Original: {len(entries)} objects, {orig_page_count} page(s)")

    # --- Build cover page ---
    today = date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y").replace(" 0", " ")
    title = "Annual Financial Report"
    print(f"Current date (environment): {date_str}")

    # Cover content stream (uncompressed)
    title_w = string_width(title, bold=True, size=32)
    date_w = string_width(date_str, bold=False, size=18)
    tx = (612 - title_w) / 2.0
    dx = (612 - date_w) / 2.0
    line_y = 502
    line_x1 = 306 - title_w / 2.0
    line_x2 = 306 + title_w / 2.0
    content = (
        "BT\n"
        "/F2 32 Tf\n"
        "0.09 0.15 0.30 rg\n"
        f"{tx:.2f} 520 Td\n"
        f"({esc_pdf_string(title)}) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
        "0.09 0.15 0.30 RG\n"
        "2 w\n"
        f"{line_x1:.2f} {line_y} m\n"
        f"{line_x2:.2f} {line_y} l\n"
        "S\n"
        "BT\n"
        "/F1 18 Tf\n"
        "0.20 0.20 0.22 rg\n"
        f"{dx:.2f} 458 Td\n"
        f"({esc_pdf_string(date_str)}) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
    ).encode("latin-1")

    obj9 = (
        b"9 0 obj\n"
        b"<<\n"
        b"/Contents 10 0 R /MediaBox [ 0 0 612 792 ] /Parent 7 0 R "
        b"/Resources << /Font 1 0 R /ProcSet [ /PDF /Text ] >> /Rotate 0 /Type /Page\n"
        b">>\n"
        b"endobj\n"
    )
    obj10 = (
        b"10 0 obj\n"
        b"<< /Length " + str(len(content)).encode() + b" >>\n"
        b"stream\n" + content + b"\nendstream\n"
        b"endobj\n"
    )

    # Rewritten Pages object: original kid 4 0 R, cover kid 9 0 R
    obj7_new = (
        b"7 0 obj\n"
        b"<<\n"
        b"/Count 2 /Kids [ 9 0 R 4 0 R ] /Type /Pages\n"
        b">>\n"
        b"endobj\n"
    )

    # --- Assemble new file: header, new objects, copied originals (7 replaced) ---
    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.3\n")
    offsets = {}
    for num in (9, 10):
        body = obj9 if num == 9 else obj10
        offsets[num] = len(out)
        out += body
        out += b"\n"
    for num in sorted(objs):
        if num == 7:
            continue
        offsets[num] = len(out)
        out += objs[num]
    offsets[7] = len(out)
    out += obj7_new
    out += b"\n"

    xref_pos = len(out)
    size = max(offsets) + 1
    out += b"xref\n"
    out += f"0 {size}\n".encode()
    for i in range(size):
        if i == 0:
            out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
        else:
            out += f"{offsets[i]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode()

    id1 = os.urandom(16).hex().upper()
    id2 = os.urandom(16).hex().upper()
    out += (
        b"trailer\n"
        b"<< /Size " + str(size).encode() +
        b" /Root 5 0 R /Info 6 0 R /ID [<" + id1.encode() + b"><" + id2.encode() + b">] >>\n"
        b"startxref\n" + str(xref_pos).encode() + b"\n%%EOF\n"
    )

    # --- In-memory verification before writing ---
    tmp = bytes(out)
    tmp_path = "_cover_check.pdf"
    with open(tmp_path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(tmp)
    verify_pdf(tmp_path, expect_pages=orig_page_count + 1, title=title, date_str=date_str)

    # --- Commit: replace report.pdf with the merged document ---
    with open(SRC, "wb") as f:
        f.write(tmp)
    os.remove(tmp_path)

    # --- Re-verify the committed file on disk ---
    verify_pdf(SRC, expect_pages=orig_page_count + 1, title=title, date_str=date_str)
    print(f"Done: {SRC} now has a cover page ({orig_page_count + 1} pages total).")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

HELV = [278,278,355,556,556,889,667,191,333,333,389,584,278,333,278,278,
        556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,278,278,584,584,584,556,
        1015,667,667,722,722,667,611,778,722,278,500,667,556,833,722,778,
        667,778,722,667,611,722,667,944,667,667,611,278,278,278,469,556,
        333,556,556,500,556,556,278,556,556,222,222,500,222,833,556,556,
        556,556,333,500,278,556,500,722,500,500,500,334,260,334,584]
HELV_BOLD = [278,333,474,556,556,889,722,238,333,333,389,584,278,333,278,278,
             556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,556,333,333,584,584,584,611,
             975,722,722,722,722,667,611,778,722,278,556,722,611,833,722,778,
             667,778,722,667,611,722,667,944,667,667,611,333,278,333,584,556,
             333,556,611,556,611,556,333,611,611,278,278,556,278,889,611,611,
             611,611,389,556,333,611,556,778,556,556,500,389,280,389,584]
assert len(HELV) == 95 and len(HELV_BOLD) == 95, "width tables must have 95 entries"


def string_width(s, bold, size):
    widths = HELV_BOLD if bold else HELV
    total = 0
    for ch in s:
        o = ord(ch)
        total += widths[o - 32] if 32 <= o <= 126 else 556
    return total * size / 1000.0


def esc_pdf_string(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def find_line_end(data, p):
    """Return index just past the next newline (handles \\r\\n)."""
    i = data.find(b"\n", p)
    if i == -1:
        raise ValueError("unterminated line")
    return i + 1


def find_dict_end(data, start):
    """Return index of the '>>' closing the dict that starts at 'start' ('<<')."""
    depth = 0
    i = start
    n = len(data)
    while i < n:
        c = data[i]
        if c == ord("("):
            # literal string; skip to matching close, honoring backslash escapes
            depth_str = 0
            i += 1
            while i < n:
                if data[i] == ord("\\"):
                    i += 2
                    continue
                if data[i] == ord("("):
                    depth_str += 1
                elif data[i] == ord(")"):
                    if depth_str == 0:
                        break
                    depth_str -= 1
                i += 1
        elif c == ord("<") and i + 1 < n and data[i + 1] == ord("<"):
            depth += 1
            i += 2
            continue
        elif c == ord(">") and i + 1 < n and data[i + 1] == ord(">"):
            depth -= 1
            i += 2
            if depth == 0:
                return i - 1
            continue
        i += 1
    raise ValueError("unbalanced dict")


def parse_classic_xref(data, startxref):
    """Parse classic xref (with /Prev chains). Returns {objnum: offset}, trailer bytes."""
    entries = {}
    trailer = None
    pos = startxref
    while pos:
        if data[pos:pos + 4] != b"xref":
            raise ValueError(f"expected 'xref' at {pos}")
        p = pos + 4
        while True:
            line_end = find_line_end(data, p)
            line = data[p:line_end].rstrip(b"\r\n")
            if not line:
                p = line_end
                continue
            if line == b"trailer":
                ds = data.index(b"<<", p)
                de = find_dict_end(data, ds)
                trailer = data[ds:de + 2]
                m = re.search(rb"/Prev\s+(\d+)", trailer)
                pos = int(m.group(1)) if m else 0
                break
            parts = line.split()
            start = int(parts[0])
            count = int(parts[1])
            q = line_end
            for _ in range(count):
                entry = data[q:q + 20]
                if len(entry) < 20:
                    raise ValueError("short xref entry")
                typ = entry[17:18]
                if typ == b"n":
                    entries[start] = int(entry[0:10])
                start += 1
                q += 20
            p = q
        # pos updated in the 'trailer' branch
    return entries, trailer


def read_objects(data, entries, boundary):
    """Return dict {objnum: raw bytes from 'N 0 obj' to next object start}."""
    objs = {}
    nums = sorted(entries.keys())
    for idx, num in enumerate(nums):
        off = entries[num]
        end = entries[nums[idx + 1]] if idx + 1 < len(nums) else boundary
        objs[num] = data[off:end]
    return objs


def verify_pdf(path, expect_pages, title, date_str):
    data = open(path, "rb").read()
    m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
    assert m, "no startxref"
    entries, _ = parse_classic_xref(data, int(m.group(1)))
    # every entry must point at '<num> 0 obj'
    for num, off in entries.items():
        header = data[off:off + 40]
        assert re.match(rb"^\s*%d\s+0\s+obj" % num, header), f"bad offset for obj {num}"
    # Pages object (7) must have Count == expect_pages and cover kid first
    p7 = data[entries[7]:entries[7] + 300]
    mcount = re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", p7)
    assert mcount and int(mcount.group(1)) == expect_pages, f"Pages /Count != {expect_pages}"
    assert b"/Kids [ 9 0 R 4 0 R ]" in p7, "Kids not updated"
    # Cover page object 9
    p9 = data[entries[9]:entries[9] + 300]
    assert b"/Type /Page" in p9 and b"/Parent 7 0 R" in p9, "cover page dict wrong"
    # Cover content stream object 10
    p10 = data[entries[10]:entries[10] + 4000]
    assert esc_pdf_string(title).encode("latin-1") in p10, "title missing in stream"
    assert esc_pdf_string(date_str).encode("latin-1") in p10, "date missing in stream"
    # trailer root
    trailer_start = data.rfind(b"trailer")
    assert b"/Root 5 0 R" in data[trailer_start:trailer_start + 200], "trailer root wrong"
    print("Verification passed: pages =", expect_pages, "| title + date found on cover.")

def main():
    if not os.path.exists(SRC):
        raise SystemExit(f"{SRC} not found")

    with open(SRC, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()

    m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
    assert m, "no startxref in original"
    startxref = int(m.group(1))

    entries, trailer = parse_classic_xref(data, startxref)
    if b"/Encrypt" in trailer:
        raise SystemExit("original PDF is encrypted; cannot merge safely")
    if b"/XRefStm" in trailer or b"/ObjStm" in data:
        raise SystemExit("original uses xref streams/object streams; not supported here")

    objs = read_objects(data, entries, startxref)
    orig_page_count = int(re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", objs[7]).group(1))
    print(f"Original: {len(entries)} objects, {orig_page_count} page(s)")

    # --- Build cover page ---
    today = date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y").replace(" 0", " ")
    title = "Annual Financial Report"
    print(f"Current date (environment): {date_str}")

    # Cover content stream (uncompressed)
    title_w = string_width(title, bold=True, size=32)
    date_w = string_width(date_str, bold=False, size=18)
    tx = (612 - title_w) / 2.0
    dx = (612 - date_w) / 2.0
    line_y = 502
    line_x1 = 306 - title_w / 2.0
    line_x2 = 306 + title_w / 2.0
    content = (
        "BT\n"
        "/F2 32 Tf\n"
        "0.09 0.15 0.30 rg\n"
        f"{tx:.2f} 520 Td\n"
        f"({esc_pdf_string(title)}) Tj\n"

        "0.09 0.15 0.30 RG\n"
        "2 w\n"
        f"{line_x1:.2f} {line_y} m\n"
        f"{line_x2:.2f} {line_y} l\n"
        "S\n"
        "BT\n"
        "/F1 18 Tf\n"
        "0.20 0.20 0.22 rg\n"
        f"{dx:.2f} 458 Td\n"
        f"({esc_pdf_string(date_str)}) Tj\n"

    ).encode("latin-1")

    obj9 = (

        b"<<\n"
        b"/Contents 10 0 R /MediaBox [ 0 0 612 792 ] /Parent 7 0 R "
        b"/Resources << /Font 1 0 R /ProcSet [ /PDF /Text ] >> /Rotate 0 /Type /Page\n"
        b">>\n"
        b"endobj\n"
    )
    obj10 = (
        b"10 0 obj\n"
        b"<< /Length " + str(len(content)).encode() + b" >>\n"
        b"stream\n" + content + b"\nendstream\n"

    )

    # Rewritten Pages object: original kid 4 0 R, cover kid 9 0 R
    obj7_new = (

        b"<<\n"
        b"/Count 2 /Kids [ 9 0 R 4 0 R ] /Type /Pages\n"
        b">>\n"
        b"endobj\n"
    )

    # --- Assemble new file: header, new objects, copied originals (7 replaced) ---
    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.3\n")
    offsets = {}
    for num in (9, 10):
        body = obj9 if num == 9 else obj10
        offsets[num] = len(out)
        out += body
        out += b"\n"
    for num in sorted(objs):
        if num == 7:
            continue
        offsets[num] = len(out)
        out += objs[num]
    offsets[7] = len(out)
    out += obj7_new
    out += b"\n"

    xref_pos = len(out)
    size = max(offsets) + 1
    out += b"xref\n"
    out += f"0 {size}\n".encode()
    for i in range(size):
        if i == 0:

        else:
            out += f"{offsets[i]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode()

    id1 = os.urandom(16).hex().upper()

        b"trailer\n"
        b"<< /Size " + str(size).encode() +
        b" /Root 5 0 R /Info 6 0 R /ID [<" + id1.encode() + b"><" + id2.encode() + b">] >>\n"
        b"startxref\n" + str(xref_pos).encode() + b"\n%%EOF\n"

    # --- In-memory verification before writing ---

    tmp_path = "_cover_check.pdf"

    with open(SRC, "wb") as f:

    # --- Re-verify the committed file on disk ---
